# Test Fixtures

Synthetic test archives generated programmatically for Comiscopio worker tests.
All image content is generated with Python (stdlib only, no external dependencies).

## Regenerating

```bash
python3 generate-fixtures.py
```

Requirements: Python 3.10+, `7z`, `rar` (optional — only for CBR), `fpdf2` (optional — only for PDF).

```bash
python3 -m venv ../.venv
source ../.venv/bin/activate
pip install fpdf2
```

## Contents

### archive/

| File | Format | Pages | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test-5pages.cbz` | ZIP | 5 | Main archive fixture — used by most tests |
| `test-5pages.cbr` | RAR5 | 5 | RAR backend test |
| `test-5pages.cb7` | 7z | 5 | 7z backend test |
| `test-5pages.cbt` | TAR | 5 | TAR backend test |
| `test-single.cbz` | ZIP | 1 | Edge case: single-page archive |
| `test-empty.cbz` | ZIP | 0 | Error case: archive with no image files |
| `test-not-images.tar` | TAR | — | Error case: TAR containing CBR files, not images |

### doc/

| File | Format | Pages | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `test-5pages.pdf` | PDF | 5 | PDF doc-worker test |
| `test-5pages.epub` | EPUB | 5 | EPUB doc-worker test |

## Page content

Each page is a 200×300 px solid-colour PNG (red, green, blue, yellow, purple).
Files are named `0001.png`…`0005.png` inside the archives.

## Licensing

All content is original synthetic data generated by `generate-fixtures.py`.
No third-party images or copyrighted material is included.
